## Reject Request (RR)

Domain-neutral rejection for any request-shaped card: a reason is REQUIRED (an unexplained rejection is unactionable and audit-useless), the consumer names the status the card returns to (only the domain knows whether "back" means draft or rejected), and the document identity is never touched — a rejected PO keeps its number. Mutate-and-save idiom (target type unknown); a rejectionReason the type declares is filled, one it doesn’t is carried in the result.

### Example

Natural target: the linked PO-2026-0042 (pending approval — rejecting it demonstrates number preservation).

### Non-goals

No notification delivery (no channel primitive; the Notify concept owns that). No counter-proposal flow.
